capabilities: Transform Japanese prose into shuffled variations in a separate read-only view
Build a weighted vocabulary from the current note or selected notes
Generate Fake Dictionary definitions, fake proverbs and Recompose text from the vocabulary
Manually shuffle, restore or replace individual words in the generated text
Copy or collect generated fragments into a configured Markdown collection file
disambiguation: Despite the name suggesting semantic search or AI tooling, it is a local Japanese text-shuffling toy for creative writing with no network use.
extras: Desktop only (requires Obsidian Desktop 1.13.7+); mobile unsupported. main.js is 14-16 MB because it embeds WebAssembly and the dictionary, exceeding Obsidian Sync Standard's 5 MB per-file limit. A browser-based web playground exists that needs no installation. Only Japanese text can be transformed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to locally generate creative text variations of Japanese prose without altering the original note.

relations.evidence: The analyzer is Lindera WebAssembly with an embedded compact IPADIC dictionary.

summary: Desktop-only creative writing plugin that makes meaning-disrupting variations of Japanese Markdown notes in a separate view, without changing the source note.
